explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial chose a2, reached S2 by the common transition and was rewarded; GO and D2 are always 0, and D1 is 0 after any unrewarded trial, any rare transition (even a rewarded one) or any a1 choice. When it fires it hits 10 on the second and later rewarded a2-to-S2 trials in a row around trials 13-30, about 8 on the first such trial after a loss, and is weaker later in the episode (about 5-7 for a run, and only 0-3 on the first reward right after a loss).
